precedenceResolution: §12.41 specifies new discussion/specification revision and new authority only after OWNER approval. It does not require terminal source job. Approved admission rule adds precise immutable input eligibility; frozen basis is not execution authority and does not bypass later approval. §25.11 terminal immutability applies to source job own state; accepting isolated child does not mutate source state. §49.4 exact scoped replay is checked before fresh source admission; replay uses frozen original descriptor rather than current pointers. §49.5 child mutation/audit/outbox atomicity remains mandatory.
limitations: Matrix other-kind rows are OPEN, not verified admission policies.
Reference server eligibility flags stand for transactionally computed sufficiency; real parser/schema/resource eligibility must be implemented and proven separately.
No SQL lock, commit, durable byte hydration or production consumer proof is claimed.
Imported authority section snapshots must be rebound to current SSOT after integration; byte extraction is not whole-document semantic review.
